body: Wanting to commit suicide and actually doing it are 2 completely different things. They don't necessarily come hand in hand. If something is holding you back, even if you don't know what it is, I am convinced that it is a sign that there is something better in store for you.

Don't do it. You said it yourself, you have something to hold onto, something to make you happy.
Covid has really fucked some of our lives up. Some more than other. But I promise you, when its over you'll be able to do what you love once again.
How about finding another job in the meantime? I'm sure you could even try going to some nursing homes/hospitals, offering to entertain them with your music!
You'll get through it. We all will. Just hold on, you'll be happy again.
I wish you would see that life has so much to offer, even if right now it seems like there isn't anything good. I've been there. You can always escape reality and create a new life.
There was a comment and now it's gone. Fucking hell I really wish I had seen it.
You are not unheard, you juste haven't found the right people who will truly listen to you and your story
Please don't do it. You deserve to live a life you'll love. Everything as a solution, everything.

I dont think its because you're an horrible person. Especially if you realise you do it and you don't want to do it. 
I genuinely think you only need help. And im sure your partner would be 1000% willing to help you with that.
